description: AI-powered business card scanner that captures images and extracts contact information automatically using Google's Gemini AI. This tool streamlines the process of digitizing contact details from physical business cards.

pages.name: BusinessCardScannerComponent
pages.description: This modal component provides an interface for capturing or uploading business card images and processing them with AI to extract contact information. It's designed to be intuitive for quick data entry.

buttons.label: Toggle Camera
buttons.description: Switches between the front and back camera on mobile devices. This helps users find the best angle and lighting for capturing the business card clearly.
when_to_use: When the current camera view is not optimal for capturing the business card.
If you need to switch from a selfie camera to a rear camera or vice-versa.

buttons.label: Capture
buttons.description: Takes a photo of the business card using the active camera. This image will then be used for AI processing.
when_to_use: When you have positioned the business card within the on-screen frame and it is clearly visible.
To initiate the photo-taking process after ensuring good lighting and focus.

buttons.label: Scan
buttons.description: Processes the captured or uploaded business card image using AI to automatically extract contact information such as name, company, title, phone, email, and address.
when_to_use: After successfully capturing a new business card image.
After uploading an existing business card image from your device.
To initiate the AI-powered data extraction process.

buttons.label: Retake
buttons.description: Discards the currently captured image and reactivates the camera, allowing you to take a new photo of the business card.
when_to_use: When the previously captured image is blurry, poorly lit, or the card was not fully in frame.
If you want to try capturing the card again for better results before scanning.

buttons.label: Upload Image
buttons.description: Allows you to select and upload an existing image of a business card from your device's storage instead of taking a new photo.
when_to_use: When you already have a photo of a business card saved on your computer or mobile device.
If your device's camera is not working or you prefer to use a pre-existing image.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're having trouble, ensure the business card is placed on a flat, well-lit surface with good contrast. Position the card within the on-screen overlay frame. You can either use your device's camera to 'Capture' a new photo or 'Upload Image' if you already have a picture. Once the image is clear, click 'Scan' to extract the details. If the image is blurry, use 'Retake'.
common_tasks: Scanning a business card: Place the card in the camera's view, click 'Capture', then click 'Scan'.
Using an existing image: Click 'Upload Image', select the photo from your device, then click 'Scan'.
Improving scan quality: If the scan is poor, click 'Retake' to capture a clearer photo, or adjust lighting and card position.
Switching cameras (mobile): Click 'Toggle Camera' to switch between front and rear cameras for better angles.
Extracting data: After capturing or uploading, always click 'Scan' to process the image with AI and get the contact details.
